questions.stem: For some drugs, there is a correlation between the plasma concentration and clinical efficacy. The dose can be adjusted based on the plasma concentration. This is called?
questions.solutionHtml:
Therapeutic drug monitoring

Explanation: Therapeutic drug monitoring – for some drugs, there is a correlation between plasma concentration and clinical efficacy. The dose can be adjusted based on the plasma concentration.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 42

questions.stem: A 40-year-old male was diagnosed with bipolar disorder. The psychiatrist decided to start lithium therapy. How much plasma concentration of lithium levels is to be maintained for treating acute mania?
questions.solutionHtml:
1 - 1.5mEq/L
  • Maintenance of bipolar disorder =6 – 1 mEq/L
  • Acute mania = 1 – 1.5mEq/L
  • Toxicity = > 1.5mEq /L
  • Dialysis = > 3 mEq


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 476

questions.stem: A 30-year-old female was diagnosed with generalized tonic-clonic seizures. The neurologist prescribed her tablet phenytoin 500mg twice daily for a month and asked her to review it after 1 month. After 1 month, the patient told that her seizures are not controlled So the doctor decided to measure the plasma concentration of phenytoin which was found to be 4 µg/ml. What is the therapeutic plasma concentration of phenytoin?
questions.solutionHtml:
10 - 20 µg/ml
  • Explanation: Therapeutic plasma concentration of phenytoin = 10 – 20 µg/ml
  • 20 µg/ml = toxicity manifested by nystagmus


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:440

questions.stem: A 30-year-old male was suffering from mania and the doctor decided to start him on lithium therapy. Since lithium is a drug narrow safety margin, the doctor decided to do therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM). Which of the following is TRUE regarding TDM?

options.label: A
options.text: Patient compliance can be checked with the help of TDM

options.label: B
options.text: TDM is useful for drugs like antihypertensives

options.label: C
options.text: In case of failure of response without any apparent reason

questions.solutionHtml:
A and C

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:42

questions.stem: Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) is the clinical practice of measuring specific drugs at designated intervals to maintain a constant concentration in a patient's bloodstream, thereby optimizing individual dosage regimens. Which of the following drug does not require TDM?
questions.solutionHtml:
Metformin
  • Metformin efficacy can be checked by measuring the blood glucose levels and it does not need TDM
  • All the other drugs have low safety of margins and require TDM


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:42

questions.stem: Therapeutic drug monitoring is useful in which of the following drugs?
questions.solutionHtml:
Digoxin

Digoxin is a medicine used for the treatment of heart failure in combination with other medicines. It helps to provide symptomatic relief by making the heart pump blood more efficiently. This medicine is also used to treat abnormal heart rhythms (arrhythmia).



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:42

questions.stem: A 50-year-old male was suffering from congestive cardiac failure. the cardiologist decided to start digoxin and he advise the patient to give samples for therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) during this therapy. Which of the following is FALSE regarding indications of TDM?

questions.answerText: A drug with a well-defined clinical endpoint

questions.stem: A 30-year-old male was diagnosed with bipolar disorder and the psychiatrist started him on lithium. Which of the following is TRUE regarding Therapeutic drug monitoring for lithium?
